description: No clean concept. Fires mostly in the opening (ply 3-16) while the centre column is empty or has one stone, more so when my bottom-row stones sit on columns 1-2 and/or 4-5 (e.g. .XX..OO) and the opponent holds the bottom-right corner; my stone in a bottom corner or their stone on (0,1)/(0,5) suppresses it. Very sensitive to single stones and not mirror-symmetric.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or to zero changes every column's probability by under 0.1.
notes: Tried: double-threat setup move (F1 0.04), centre-empty opening (F1 0.18, AUROC 0.70), bottom-row patterns alone (F1 0.07-0.13), centre-empty gate + bottom-row cell weights (F1 0.225, best; sim share 0.03). Minimal pairs show strong but idiosyncratic single-stone effects (crossing 2x2 patterns at cols 1-2 and 5-6 fire, other columns do not). Steering effect negligible. Likely a mixture or random direction. One score call wasted by a duplicate run.
